content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Associate- Household & Personal Finance Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Associate- Household & Personal Finance position at IIT Roorkee is 10 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply well before this deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate- Household & Personal Finance post under the current recruitment notification (Advt No: BMG-3102-HSD/26-27) released by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate- Household & Personal Finance role will receive a monthly consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 60,000, depending on qualifications and experience as per the institute's norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly through email. Candidates must prepare their bio-data and supporting documents, then send them to the official email address provided in the detailed notification document.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates, including General, OBC, SC, and ST. The application process is completely free of cost for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Econometrics, or a closely related field. Additionally, candidates should possess strong skills in Python, R, and LATEX, along with experience in econometric modeling and quantitative research.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate- Household & Personal Finance post consists of an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend the interview, where their technical skills and research experience will be evaluated.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee. It is a project-based recruitment, and the tenure of the job will be governed by the specific project requirements and the institute's policies.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India who meet the specified educational and technical eligibility criteria are eligible to apply for this position at IIT Roorkee, provided they fulfill the requirements mentioned in the official notification.
